source_findings: Empty graph silently selects a default; graph lookup does not reject ambiguity.
No idle editor guard; undo records graph but not Blueprint or existing endpoint nodes.
Preview can promise a shared knot but Apply creates one knot per wire.
Geometry uses fallback rectangles; comments overstate restoration and behavioral safety.
limitations: Acceptance is limited to reproducible synthetic Blueprint routing scenarios, not all graph shapes or node classes.
Crossing counts use straight physical segments, not native spline collision; visual inspection remains necessary.
Bounded candidates can refuse a route that a more general routing algorithm could find; existing knots are left untouched.
Schema failure recovery reports partial/restoration-unverified; callback failures and rollback paths were source-reviewed but not exhaustively fault-injected.
No automatic compilation, saving or runtime-behavior certification.
